name: Soul Upload
description: A computer is protected by a hybrid trap, which uploads the soul of all unauthorized users to an inert data module on the computer.
disable: DC 36 Arcana (expert) to drain the computer's magical energy, or DC 36 Computers (expert) to falsify authorized credentials, or DC 40 Thievery (expert) to disable the trap, or Dispel Magic (7th rank; counteract DC 34) to counteract the trap

offensiveAbilities.name: Upload Soul
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger An unauthorized creature grasps the computer directly or with a tool

Effect The trap attempts to upload the triggering creature's soul into the computer. The triggering creature must attempt a DC 40 Will Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes (3d10+15) Spirit Damage damage.

Failure The creature's soul is temporarily pulled from their body. It takes (6d10+30) Spirit Damage damage and is Stunned 3.

Critical Failure The creature's soul is pulled from its body and uploaded to a data module on the computer. Its body remains a soulless vessel, which slowly dies over the course of 1 week unless its soul is returned. Destroying the computer destroys its soul.
